usage_requirements: Every input MUST be prefixed: 'query: ' for queries and 'passage: ' for passages in retrieval; use 'query: ' on BOTH sides for symmetric tasks (semantic similarity, paraphrase, clustering). Card FAQ: 'this is how the model is trained, otherwise you will see a performance degradation.'
Pooling: average (mean) pooling over the last hidden state using the attention mask (card provides an explicit average_pool function); do not use CLS pooling.
Normalize embeddings (L2) and score with cosine similarity, per the card's usage examples.
Standard BERT architecture (12 layers), loadable via AutoModel/sentence-transformers with no trust_remote_code flag in the card's usage examples.
English-only model ('This model only works for English texts').
Long texts are truncated to at most 512 tokens.
known_issues: Cosine similarity scores are compressed into roughly the 0.7-1.0 range (a consequence of the low InfoNCE temperature of 0.01 used in training), so absolute similarity thresholds are unreliable; only relative ranking is meaningful.
Omitting the 'query: '/'passage: ' prefixes degrades quality silently -- the model still returns embeddings with no error.
English-only; non-English input is out of distribution.
unknowns: params_millions (HF card and API response inspected did not expose a total parameter count; card states only '12 layers and the embedding size is 768')
mteb_average_score (no aggregate MTEB average found on the model card, the E5 GitHub README, or accessible leaderboard data; only per-task scores are published)
